author: Justifier925
body:
I can’t read your stats, but it looks like you were “doomed”. 

Halloween monsters can trick or treat. When they trick, they can give you a doom effect which will kill you if you can’t complete the fight in time. There’s a counter that shows how many turns you have left. Once the counter is gone the next turn will be fatal. 

I believe panacea can (edit: can’t) cure it, you’re better off restarting the fight.

author: Widogeist
body: Just something to add regarding doom: Pumpkinless/Arisen Pumpkinless raids can trigger doom with their "trick" ability. If you use a follower/pet/summon with the "cleanse" or "dispel" ability, it *will* get rid of doom.
